basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm a 31-year-old Pokémon enthusiast based in Columbus, Ohio. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me the flexibility to indulge in my hobbies, particularly Pokémon trading and online gaming. I'm generally online in the evenings after 7 PM, and during weekends. I'm currently single and enjoy attending local gaming meetups when possible. While I'm fairly new to Reddit, I'm eager to engage with the community and learn more about the mechanics of Pokémon trades. Besides Pokémon, I have a growing interest in exploring various subcultures and communities online.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a basic understanding of Pokémon trading, primarily self-taught through online guides and forums. My knowledge is expanding as I actively participate in trades and discussions on the 'pokemontrades' subreddit. I also enjoy learning about different Pokémon stats and breeding techniques.
